method: Re-inspected original 24 JPEGs in four six-frame sheets, all 55 recovered frames in eleven five-frame sheets, and new native CT frame individually; hashes independently verified. Four new Pit frames inspected individually against poses.

coverage_exclusions.QA_CT_RECOVERY_WEST: Crate blocks reverse passage; excluded as reverse route evidence.
coverage_exclusions.QA_CT_RECOVERY_SOUTH: Debug ray overlay; clean side replacement exists in directional batch.
coverage_exclusions.QA_SHORT_G1_NX_001: Close wall blocks requested route read.
coverage_exclusions.QA_LOWTUN_G1_DOWN_001: Crate top occludes the floor sample; cannot represent tunnel floor.
coverage_exclusions.QA_BSITE_G1_NY_001: Foreground cover blocks tunnel exit; relocate for reverse route.
coverage_exclusions.QA_ASITE_G1_PX_001: Central cover blocks site platform read.

limitations: All non-excluded images are partial study references. No full area certification. Old overhead views are perspective and roof-occluded; not truth-map evidence. B exterior original is low eye and does not establish standing clearance.
